messages.content: Exam mein 'explain' aur 'describe' mein kya farak hota hai? Teacher ne bola dono alag hain.

To describe means to say what something is like: how it looks, its parts or its steps. To explain means to say why or how something happens. For example, "Describe a volcano" asks what it looks like. "Explain why volcanoes erupt" asks for the reasons.
Papa ka retirement hai next week. Unke liye English mein ek chhoti si speech line chahiye, thodi emotional.

You could say: "Papa, you worked hard for thirty-five years so that we could have everything we needed. Today we are proud of you, and we are happy that you can finally rest and enjoy your time." Change the number of years to fit.
My friend is saying 'I am having two brothers.' Is it correct english?
Not quite. Say: "I have two brothers." When "have" means owning something or having family, we do not use the -ing form. "I am having" is fine for actions, like "I am having lunch."
Dhaba pe kuch foreigners aaye the. Unko kaise samjhaun ki dal makhani spicy nahi hai, creamy hai?
You can say: "Dal makhani is not spicy. It is rich and creamy, made with black lentils, butter and cream." If they want something mild, add: "This one is a good choice if you don't like spicy food."
Train mein meri seat pe koi baitha hai. Politely kaise bolun ki ye meri seat hai?
Try: "Excuse me, I think this is my seat. My ticket says seat 42." Show your ticket if needed. Saying "I think" keeps it polite, in case there is a mistake.
Aur agar woh bole ki adjust kar lo?
You can say: "I'm sorry, but I'd really like my own seat. I have a long journey." If you don't mind sharing for a while, say: "Okay, that's fine for now."
Correct this please: 'Kindly revert back to me at the earliest.'

Better: "Please reply to me as soon as you can." "Revert" means to go back to an earlier state, so many readers find it odd in place of "reply". Also, "revert back" repeats itself, because "re-" already means "back".
Doctor ko English mein kaise bataun ki mujhe raat ko neend nahi aati?
You can say: "I have trouble sleeping at night." Or: "I can't fall asleep at night." If it has gone on for some time, add how long: "This has been happening for about two weeks."
Mera dost mujhse 2000 rupees udhaar maang raha hai. How to say no without hurting him?
You could say: "I'm really sorry, but I can't lend money right now. I hope you understand." Keep it short and kind. You don't have to give a long reason.
Diwali pe office colleagues ko message bhejna hai English mein. Kuch simple aur professional?
Try this: "Wishing you and your family a happy and bright Diwali. May the year ahead bring you good health and success." It is warm but still suitable for work.
What is the meaning of 'neck and neck'? Commentator was saying in kabaddi match.
"Neck and neck" means two sides are almost equal in a race or contest, so it is hard to say who will win. Example: "The two teams were neck and neck until the last raid."
Bacchon ko samjhana hai ki ped kyun zaroori hain. English mein 2-3 simple lines do.
Here are three lines: "Trees give us clean air to breathe. They give us shade, fruit and wood. Birds and many animals make their homes in trees, so we must take care of them."
I am read this book since last month but not finish. Correct my sentence please.

Corrected: "I have been reading this book since last month, but I have not finished it yet." Use "have been reading" for an action that started in the past and is still going on. Use "have not finished" for something that is not done until now.
Jab koi compliment de toh English mein kya bolna chahiye? Main hamesha 'no no' bol deta hoon.
Just say: "Thank you, that's very kind of you." Or: "Thanks, I'm glad you like it." Saying "no no" can sound like you are pushing away their kind words. A simple thank-you is enough.
Kapde ki dukaan pe kaise poochun ki iska bada size hai kya?
Ask: "Do you have this in a larger size?" Or name the size: "Do you have this in large?"
Aur trial room kahan hai, woh kaise poochun?
Say: "Where is the trial room?" In many countries people say "fitting room" or "changing room", so you can use those words too.
'Aaj bahut umas hai' ko English mein kaise bolenge?
You can say: "It's very humid today." Or, more casually: "It's so sticky today." "Humid" means the air feels heavy and wet.
Upar wale flat se roz raat ko bahut noise aata hai. Unko ek polite note likhna hai English mein.

Hello,

I live in the flat below yours. I can often hear loud sounds late at night, and it makes it hard for me to sleep. Could you please keep the noise down after ten? Thank you for understanding.

Your neighbour, Flat 204
My message to friend: 'Call me when you will reach home.' Is it right?
Say: "Call me when you reach home." After "when" about the future, English uses the present tense, not "will". Another example: "I'll tell you when I get there."
Hostel warden ko leave application likhni hai, ghar jaana hai 3 din ke liye. Short format chahiye.

Dear Sir,

I would like to request leave from the hostel from 12 to 14 March, as I need to visit my family at home. I will return on the evening of 14 March.

Thank you.
Yours sincerely,
Ananya Iyer, Room 115
'Tadka lagana' ko recipe mein English mein kya likhun?
You can write: "Temper the dal." Or explain it: "Heat oil or ghee, add cumin seeds and other spices, and pour it over the dal." Many cookbooks also keep the word "tadka" and explain it once.
'Light chali gayi' ko English mein kaise bolte hain? I said 'light went' and my cousin laughed.
Say: "The power has gone off" or "There's a power cut." In American English, people often say "The power is out." "The light went" sounds like one bulb stopped working.
Kal school function mein mujhe anchoring karni hai. Shuruaat kaise karun English mein?

You can begin: "Good morning, respected principal, teachers and my dear friends. Welcome to our Annual Day. We have a wonderful programme for you today, so let's begin." Speak slowly and smile at the audience.
Dadi ko English sikha rahi hoon. 'Thank you' ka reply kya hota hai, simple wala?
The simplest replies are "You're welcome" and "No problem." Your dadi can also say "My pleasure" when she wants to sound a little more polite.
Dost se jhagda ho gaya. Sorry message English mein chahiye, but zyada filmy nahi.
Try: "Hey, I'm sorry about what I said yesterday. I was upset, but I shouldn't have spoken like that. Our friendship matters to me. Can we talk?"
Aur agar woh reply na kare?
Give them a little time. If you still want to reach out after a day or two, you can write: "I just wanted to check in. I'm here whenever you're ready to talk."
What is difference between 'dinner' and 'supper'? In book they write supper.

Both are evening meals. "Dinner" is the common word today. "Supper" is often a lighter or later evening meal, and it appears more in older books and in some parts of Britain. In daily speech, "dinner" is the safe choice.
Bus conductor se kaise poochun ki ye bus Lal Bagh jaayegi ya nahi?
Ask: "Does this bus go to Lal Bagh?" You can also ask: "Which stop should I get off at for Lal Bagh?"
My boss is telling 'Please prepone the meeting.' My Australian colleague not understand. Why?

"Prepone" means to move something to an earlier time. It is common in India, but many people in other countries don't know it. Say instead: "Please move the meeting to an earlier time" or "Please bring the meeting forward." Also: "My Australian colleague did not understand."
Gym trainer bolta hai 'Don't skip leg day'. Iska matlab?
It means: do not miss the day of your workout that is meant for leg exercises. Many people train their arms and chest but avoid leg exercises, so trainers say this as a friendly reminder.
Bank mein kaise bolun ki mujhe naya passbook chahiye kyunki purana bhar gaya?
You can say: "My passbook is full. Could I please get a new one?" If there is a form to fill, the staff will tell you.
Eid pe padosi ko sewaiyan dene jaa raha hoon. Dete waqt English mein kya bolun?
You can say: "Eid Mubarak! We made some sewaiyan at home, and we wanted to share them with you." If they ask, explain that sewaiyan is a sweet dish made with thin noodles and milk.
Which is correct: 'I am good in cricket' or 'I am good at cricket'?
"I am good at cricket" is correct. We use "good at" for skills and activities: good at maths, good at singing, good at chess.
Trek pe gaye the. 'Raasta bahut fisalan bhara tha' ko English mein?
Say: "The path was very slippery." You can add: "We had to walk slowly so that we wouldn't fall."
Teacher said write 'blurb' for my story. Blurb kya hota hai?

A blurb is a short piece of writing on the back cover of a book. It tells readers what the story is about, without giving away the ending, so they want to read it. Example: "A shy girl finds a map in her grandfather's trunk, and her quiet summer turns into an adventure."
Kal ke presentation ko lekar nervous feel ho raha hai. Dost ko English mein kaise bataun?
You can say: "I'm really nervous about tomorrow's presentation." Or: "I've got butterflies in my stomach about tomorrow." The second one is a common way to say you feel nervous.
Online order galat aaya. Email mein likha: 'I ordered blue shirt but you have sended red.' Fix karo.

Corrected: "I ordered a blue shirt, but I received a red one." The past of "send" is "sent", not "sended". Saying what you received also sounds more polite than "you sent". Add your order number so they can help you quickly.
What means 'it's raining cats and dogs'? Sounds very strange.

It means it is raining very hard. It is an old, playful saying, so there are no real cats or dogs. Example: "Take an umbrella, it's raining cats and dogs outside." Also, ask it like this: "What does it mean?"
Naye padosi aaye hain. Unko welcome karne ke liye kya bolun?
You can say: "Hello! I'm Kavya from the flat next door. Welcome to the building. If you need anything, just knock." A small box of sweets is a nice touch.
Phone pe network nahi aa raha tha. 'Aapki awaaz kat rahi hai' ko English mein kaise bolun?
Say: "Sorry, you're breaking up." Or: "I can't hear you clearly. The line is bad." Then you can add: "Can I call you back?"
Professor ko mail mein kaise likhun ki assignment ki deadline extend kar dijiye?

You could write: "Dear Professor Menon, I am writing to ask if I could have two more days for the assignment. I was unwell last week and could not finish it on time. I would be very grateful for an extension. Regards, Farhan"
'Doodh ubal ke gir gaya' ko English mein?
Say: "The milk boiled over." "Boil over" means a liquid rises and spills out of the pot while it is boiling.
My sentence: 'Please on the fan, it is too much hot.' What is wrong?
Say: "Please turn on the fan. It is too hot." In English, "on" is not a verb, so use "turn on" or "switch on". Also, say "too hot" or "very hot", not "too much hot".
Beta pooch raha hai: 'informations' sahi hai ya 'information'?
"Information" is correct. It is uncountable, so it has no plural. Say "some information" or "a piece of information". Example: "The teacher gave us useful information about the trip."
Mere bhai ki shaadi hai. Card pe English mein invitation line chahiye.

Here is one: "With great joy, the Sharma family invites you to the wedding of Aditya and Meera on Sunday, 15 December, at Shanti Gardens. Your presence will make the day special." Change the names, date and place.
Meaning of 'third wheel'? My friends call me that when I go out with them and their girlfriend.
A "third wheel" is a person who is with a couple and feels a little extra or left out. Example: "I didn't want to be the third wheel, so I stayed home." Your friends probably say it as a joke.
Restaurant mein waiter ko kaise bolun ki khana thoda kam spicy banana?
Say: "Could you make it less spicy, please?" Or: "Please make it mild." If you can't eat chilli at all, say: "No chilli, please."
Hotel reception pe bolna hai: 'Room mein AC kaam nahi kar raha.' English?
Say: "The AC in my room isn't working. Could someone please check it?" Mention your room number too: "I'm in room 308."
Interview mein poocha 'What are your weaknesses?' Mere mann mein hai: main kabhi kabhi zyada detail mein chala jaata hoon. English mein kaise bolun?
You can say: "Sometimes I spend too much time on small details. I'm learning to set a time limit for each task, so I finish on time." It is honest, and it shows you are working on it.
'Mera pair moch gaya' English mein kaise bolein?
Say: "I've sprained my ankle." If it's another part, name it: "I've twisted my foot." "Sprain" means you hurt a joint by twisting it.
Is it correct: 'I don't have money for buying new phone'?
Better: "I don't have the money to buy a new phone." Use "to" with a verb to show purpose. Also add "a" before "new phone".
Ganesh Chaturthi pe school mein 1 minute ki speech deni hai. Pehli do lines English mein do?
You can start: "Good morning, everyone. Today I will talk about Ganesh Chaturthi, the festival that welcomes Lord Ganesha into our homes and hearts."
Badminton coach bolte hain 'Keep your eye on the shuttle'. Ye idiom hai kya?

Here it is a real instruction: watch the shuttle all the time. But "keep your eye on the ball" is also an idiom. It means pay attention to what matters most. Example: "Exams are close, so keep your eye on the ball."
Ghar ke paas wali jheel bahut gandi ho gayi hai. Municipality ko complaint English mein likhni hai, short.

Dear Sir or Madam,

I live near the lake on Station Road. For the past month, people have been throwing plastic and waste into the water, and it now smells bad. Could you please arrange for it to be cleaned and put a few dustbins nearby?

Thank you.
Regards,
Suresh Nair
'Mujhe kahaniyon ki kitaabein padhna pasand hai' - translate karo.
"I like reading storybooks." You can also say: "I love reading fiction." Fiction means stories that are made up.
My friend's father passed away. What should I write in message? I don't know English words for this.

You could write: "I'm so sorry about your father. I'm thinking of you and your family. If you need anything, I'm here." Keep it short and simple. Being there for your friend matters more than perfect words.
Sabziwale se kaise poochun 'ye tamatar kaise diye'?
Ask: "How much are these tomatoes?" Or: "How much for a kilo of tomatoes?"
'Thand lag rahi hai' English mein 'I am feeling cold' sahi hai ya 'I am cold'?
Both are correct. "I'm cold" is the most common and natural. "I'm feeling cold" is also fine. Don't say "I am having cold"; that sounds like you have a cold, which is an illness.
Neighbour ki gaadi hamare gate ke saamne parked hai. How to tell politely?
You can say: "Hi, sorry to bother you. Your car is parked in front of our gate, and we need to take our car out. Could you please move it?"
Meaning of 'I'll get back to you'? My client always write this.
It means: "I will reply to you later, after I check or think about it." Example: "Let me check the dates, and I'll get back to you by Friday." A small fix: "My client always writes this."
Seniors bahut tease karte hain. Unko English mein firmly kaise bolun ki stop karo?

Say it calmly and clearly: "Please stop. I don't like this." If it goes on, you can say: "I'm not okay with this, and I will speak to the warden if it continues." It's also fine to tell a teacher or warden you trust.
My sentence for recipe: 'Cut the potatoes in small-small pieces.' Is it ok?
Write: "Cut the potatoes into small pieces." Or: "Dice the potatoes." In English, we don't repeat "small-small". Use "into" when something changes shape or form.
Plumber ko kaise bataun ki kitchen ka nal tapak raha hai?
Say: "The kitchen tap is dripping. Can you come and fix it today?" In American English, people say "faucet" instead of "tap".
Which one: 'I have a doubt' or 'I have a question'? My teacher from Canada looked confused.

Say: "I have a question." In Indian English, "doubt" often means a question, but in most other places "doubt" means you are not sure something is true. Example: "I have a question about the third problem."
Chhoti behen ka result aaya, 95%! English mein usse kya bolun, proud wala?
Tell her: "I'm so proud of you! All your hard work has paid off. Ninety-five percent is amazing." You could also say: "You did it! Let's celebrate tonight."
'Usne mujhe ignore kiya' ko English mein kaise bolein, natural way?
Say: "She ignored me." Or, more casually: "She acted like she didn't see me." Use "he" if you mean a boy or a man.
Is 'I am vegetarian' or 'I am a vegetarian' correct? Waiter ko bolna hai.
Both are correct. "I'm vegetarian" uses the word as an adjective, and "I'm a vegetarian" uses it as a noun. To the waiter, you can add: "Do you have anything without meat or eggs?"
Flight delay ho gayi. Ghar walon ko message: 'Flight late hai, 2 ghante baad pahunchungi.' English mein?
Write: "My flight is delayed. I'll reach about two hours late." Or: "My flight is running two hours late. I'll message you when I land."
Mera manager bolta hai 'Let's take this offline'. Matlab kya? Hum toh office mein hain.

It means: let's talk about this later, in a smaller group or one to one, not in this meeting. It has nothing to do with the internet. Example: "This is a big topic, so let's take it offline after the call."
Chemist se kaise poochun ki ye dawai khaane se pehle leni hai ya baad mein?
Ask: "Should I take this before or after meals?" You can also ask: "How many times a day should I take it?" Always follow what your doctor or chemist tells you.
Salary aate hi khatam ho jaati hai. 'Hand to mouth' ka matlab yahi hai kya?
Yes, close. "Living hand to mouth" means having only just enough money for daily needs, with nothing left to save. Example: "After paying rent, they were living hand to mouth."
Christmas pe mere Goan dost ko wish karna hai. 'Merry Christmas' ke alawa kya likh sakti hoon?
You can write: "Wishing you and your family a Christmas full of warmth, good food and laughter." Or: "Season's greetings! Hope you have a lovely time with everyone at home."
Mujhe likhna hai 'Hum match 3 wicket se jeet gaye'. Correct English?
Write: "We won the match by three wickets." Use "by" to show the margin: won by 20 runs, won by two goals.
My kid asked: 'Why the sky is blue?' Is his question grammar correct?
Almost. In a question, the verb comes before the subject: "Why is the sky blue?" Another example: "Why is the water cold?"
Library mein book late return ki. Librarian ko sorry kaise bolun?
Say: "I'm sorry, I'm returning this book late. I'll pay the fine." Or: "Sorry for the delay. I forgot the due date."
What is meaning of 'homesick'? I am in hostel and feeling like this I think.

"Homesick" means feeling sad because you are away from home and miss your family and familiar places. Example: "In my first month at the hostel, I was very homesick." It is a common feeling, and it usually gets easier with time.
Mall mein return counter pe bolna hai: 'Ye shoes tight hain, exchange karna hai.'
Say: "These shoes are too tight. I'd like to exchange them for a bigger size, please." Keep the bill with you.
Kya ye theek hai: 'Today weather is very nice'?
Add "the": "The weather is very nice today." Or: "It's a lovely day today." We usually say "the weather", because we mean the weather here and now.
Padosi ka kutta raat bhar bhaunkta hai. English mein 'bhaunkna'?
"Bhaunkna" is "to bark". You can say: "Our neighbour's dog barks all night."
Mera phone hang ho raha hai. Service centre mein 'hang' bolun ya kuch aur?
"Hang" is understood, but you can be clearer: "My phone keeps freezing" or "My phone stops responding." Then add: "Can you check what the problem is?"
Viva mein agar answer nahi pata toh English mein kya bolun?
Be honest and calm: "I'm not sure about this one. May I try the next question?" Or: "I don't remember the exact answer, but I think it is related to..." and then say what you know.
Ammi ki tarah biryani 'dum' pe banani hai. Dum ko English mein kaise samjhaun?
You can say: "Dum means slow cooking in a sealed pot, so the steam stays inside and cooks the rice and meat together." Some people also call it "slow steaming".
Teach me difference between 'house' and 'home'. Both same no?
Not quite. A "house" is a building. A "home" is the place where you live and feel you belong. Example: "They sold the old house, but it will always feel like home."
Principal ko application: 'I want to inform that my son will not come to school tomorrow due to he is sick.' Fix karo.

Corrected: "I would like to inform you that my son will not be able to come to school tomorrow because he is unwell." Use "because" before a full clause (he is unwell). "Due to" goes before a noun: "due to illness". Add "you" after "inform".
Nana ji ko phone pe English mein 'Aapki tabiyat kaisi hai?' poochna hai.
Ask: "How are you feeling?" or "How is your health these days?" A warm way to begin is: "Hello, Nanaji! How are you feeling today?"
Meaning of 'catch up'? Friend wrote 'let's catch up this weekend'.

Here, "catch up" means to meet and talk about what has happened in each other's lives since you last met. Example: "We hadn't met in months, so we caught up over coffee." It can also mean reaching someone who is ahead of you.
'Khana thanda ho gaya, garam kar do' - English mein waiter ko?
Say: "My food has gone cold. Could you please heat it up?" Or: "Could you please warm this up?"
Is it 'I am going to Goa by car' or 'with car'?
"By car" is correct. Use "by" for the way you travel: by bus, by train, by plane. But say "in my car" and "on foot".
My colleague wrote 'PFA' in email. Kya hota hai?
"PFA" stands for "Please find attached". It means a file is attached to the email. Many people outside India find it unclear, so it is better to write in full: "I have attached the report."
Mujhe kehna hai 'mera gala kharab hai'. Is it 'my throat is bad'?
Say: "I have a sore throat." "My throat is bad" is understood but sounds unusual. If your voice is affected, say: "I've lost my voice" or "My voice is hoarse."
Piggy bank ko English mein kuch aur bolte hain kya? Mere bete ka gullak hai.
"Piggy bank" is the most common English word for a gullak, even if it is not shaped like a pig. You can also say "money box". Example: "He puts his coins in his money box every Sunday."
Navratri mein garba khelne jaa rahe hain. Foreign friend ko garba explain kaise karun?
You can say: "Garba is a folk dance from Gujarat. During Navratri, a festival of nine nights, people dance in circles, clap and move to music."
Sentence check: 'Yesterday we have played football in rain.'
Corrected: "Yesterday we played football in the rain." With a finished time like "yesterday", use the simple past (played), not "have played". Say "in the rain".
Butterfly ka life cycle English mein simple steps mein batao.

1. Egg: the butterfly lays tiny eggs on a leaf.
2. Caterpillar: a caterpillar hatches and eats a lot of leaves.
3. Pupa: it forms a hard case around itself.
4. Adult: a butterfly comes out and flies away.
'Is kitaab ka ant bahut dukhi tha' English mein?
Say: "The ending of this book was very sad." Or: "This book had a really sad ending."
Mujhe kisi ko bolna hai ki 'tumne mera dil dukhaya'. Bina rude hue kaise bolun?
You can say: "What you said really hurt me." Or: "I felt hurt when you said that." Talking about how you felt, instead of blaming, keeps the talk calm.
What is 'window shopping'? My aunty says we are only doing that.
"Window shopping" means looking at things in shops without planning to buy anything. Example: "We went window shopping on Sunday and only bought ice cream."
School diary mein likhna hai: 'Baarish ki wajah se school band raha.'
Write: "The school was closed because of heavy rain." Or: "School was shut due to the rain."
Neighbour aunty always ask me 'When you are getting married?' In English how I change topic politely?

You can smile and say: "Not just yet, aunty. How is your garden doing?" Or: "When it happens, you'll be the first to know!" Then ask about something she enjoys. A small fix: "My neighbour aunty always asks me, 'When are you getting married?'"
Message mein 'Pls call asap' likha. Kya formal email mein bhi chalega?
Not in a formal email. Write it in full: "Please call me as soon as possible." Short forms like "pls" and "asap" are fine with friends, but they can look careless at work.
'Main final year mein hoon' English mein, 'I am in final year' sahi hai?
Add "my" or "the": "I'm in my final year" or "I'm in the final year of my degree." Example: "I'm in my final year of engineering."
Recipe likhni hai: 'Aata goondh lo.' English?
Write: "Knead the dough." To be clearer: "Mix the wheat flour with water and knead it into a soft dough."
'Ghar ki safai' ke liye English mein kya common word hai? I want to say I did full house cleaning.
Say: "I cleaned the whole house today." Or: "I did a deep clean of the house." For a big yearly cleaning, people also say "spring cleaning".
Science project ka title English mein chahiye: 'Paani bachao, jeevan bachao'.
"Save Water, Save Life." Or a slightly different version: "Every Drop Counts." Both are short and work well as titles.
Mummy papa ki anniversary pe cake pe kya likhwaun? Short sa English.
Try one of these: "Happy 25th, Mummy and Papa!" or "25 Years of Love." Change the number to match their anniversary.
Dost ne bola 'Let's go Dutch'. Matlab?
"Let's go Dutch" means each person pays for their own share, for example at a restaurant. Example: "We went Dutch on dinner."
Achha. Aur agar main uske liye pay karna chahun?
You can say: "No, this one's on me." Or: "Let me get this today. You can pay next time."
'Mujhe bhookh lagi hai' ke alawa aur tareeke English mein?
"I'm hungry" is the simplest. Others: "I'm starving" (very hungry, said casually), "I could eat something" (a little hungry) and "My stomach is growling."
Is this right: 'I reached to Delhi yesterday night'?
Corrected: "I reached Delhi last night." "Reach" does not take "to". Say "last night", not "yesterday night". You can also say: "I arrived in Delhi last night."
Salary discussion mein English mein kaise bolun ki main thoda zyada expect kar raha tha?
You can say: "Thank you for the offer. I was hoping for something closer to eight lakh, based on my experience. Is there any flexibility?" Change the figure to yours, and stay polite and calm.
'Mujhe chakkar aa rahe hain' English mein?
Say: "I feel dizzy." Or: "My head is spinning." If you need help, add: "I need to sit down."
Fix this: 'Can you borrow me 500 rupees till Monday?'
Corrected: "Can you lend me 500 rupees until Monday?" You "lend" something to someone; you "borrow" something from someone. So you could also say: "Can I borrow 500 rupees from you until Monday?"
Pongal ke baare mein ek line English mein, jo main apne Japanese colleague ko bata sakun?
"Pongal is a harvest festival from Tamil Nadu, when families cook a sweet rice dish called pongal and give thanks for a good harvest."
Mera beta pooch raha hai 'draw' aur 'tie' mein kya farak hai?

They mean almost the same thing: the game ended with equal scores. "Draw" is common in football and chess. In cricket, a "tie" means equal scores at the end, while a "draw" means the match ended without a result.
'Aasmaan mein indradhanush nikla hai' translate please.
"There is a rainbow in the sky." Or, more lively: "Look, a rainbow has come out!"
Book club mein first time ja rahi hoon. Wahan English mein apni opinion kaise shuru karun?
You can start with: "For me, the best part of the book was..." or "I felt that the main character..." These openings sound natural and give you time to think.
Agar mujhe book pasand nahi aayi toh?
That's fine to say. Try: "Honestly, it wasn't for me. I found the middle quite slow." Give one reason, so it sounds thoughtful, not rude.
Is it right: 'I am very much excited for trip'?
Better: "I'm really excited about the trip." Use "really" or "very" with "excited", not "very much". Say "excited about", and add "the" before "trip".
'Isme koi discount hai kya?' English mein shop pe kaise poochun?
Ask: "Is there any discount on this?" Or: "Is this on sale?"
Weather report mein 'drizzle' bola. Kya hota hai?
"Drizzle" is very light rain with tiny drops. Example: "It was only drizzling, so we didn't need an umbrella." It can be a noun (a drizzle) or a verb (it is drizzling).
Padosi ne hamari pooja ke time help ki. Unko thank you card mein kya likhun?

Dear Mr and Mrs Kapoor,

Thank you so much for your help during our pooja. You made everything easier for us, and we are lucky to have neighbours like you.

With warm regards,
The Reddy family
Customer care call pe 'Please hold' bolte hain. Mujhe kya karna hai?
"Please hold" means wait on the line and don't end the call. Someone will come back to you soon.
Aur 'hang up' matlab?
"Hang up" means end the call. Example: "Don't hang up, I'm still here."
Mujhe bolna hai ki maine is baare mein pehle bhi call kiya tha.
Say: "I have called about this before." Or, if it is true: "This is my third call about the same problem."
Seminar mein question poochna hai. Shuruaat kaise karun English mein bina nervous lage?
Start with: "Thank you for the talk. I have a question about..." Then ask it in one or two short sentences. Speaking slowly will help you sound calm.
'Chawal chipak gaye' English mein kya bolenge?
Say: "The rice has become sticky." If it stuck to the pot, say: "The rice stuck to the bottom of the pan."
I want to say 'Ghar shift kar rahe hain'. 'We are shifting house' correct?
In Indian English, "shifting" is common, but most English speakers say: "We are moving house" or "We are moving to a new place." Example: "We're moving next month."
'Mujhe maths se dar lagta hai' kaise bolun?
Say: "I'm scared of maths." Or: "Maths makes me nervous." Many students feel this way, and regular practice usually helps.
Mere chacha ka beta. English mein usko kya bolte?
Your chacha's son is your "cousin". English uses "cousin" for the children of any uncle or aunt. If you want to be exact, say "my cousin on my father's side".
Help me fix: 'Me and Riya is going to movie tonight.'
Corrected: "Riya and I are going to a movie tonight." Use "I" when you are part of the subject, and put the other person first. Two people take "are", not "is". Add "a" before "movie".
Mehmaan ko khaana serve karte waqt 'aur lijiye' English mein kya bolun?
Say: "Please have some more." Or: "Would you like some more?" The second one sounds a little more polite.
Mera passport kho gaya. Police station pe English mein kya bolun?
Say: "I have lost my passport, and I want to report it." They will ask where and when you last had it, so think about that before you go in.
Senior said 'let's touch base Monday'. What is meaning of touch base?
"Touch base" means to contact someone briefly to share an update or check how things are. Example: "I'll touch base with you on Monday about the plan."
Dentist ko 'daant mein thanda paani lagta hai' kaise bolun?
Say: "My teeth hurt when I drink cold water." Or: "My teeth are sensitive to cold."
Pocket money badhwani hai. Papa ko English mein politely kaise bolun?

You could say: "Papa, things cost more now, and my bus fare has gone up. Could you please increase my pocket money a little? I'll keep track of what I spend." The last line shows you are being responsible.
Raksha Bandhan pe bhai ko card mein English mein kya likhun? Woh Canada mein hai.

Dear Bhaiya,

This Rakhi I can't tie the thread on your wrist, but my love travels across the miles. Stay happy and stay safe. I miss you.

Love,
Neha
'Usne catch chhod diya' cricket mein, English?
Say: "He dropped the catch." If it was an easy one: "He dropped a simple catch."
Mere garden mein bahut ghonge aa gaye hain. 'Ghonga' English mein snail hi hai na?
Yes, "ghonga" is "snail". A snail has a shell on its back. A slug looks similar but has no shell.
Aur 'kenchua'?
"Kenchua" is "earthworm". Earthworms are good for the soil because they help air and water get into it.
Sentence: 'This novel is very interesting, I finished it in one sitting only.' Theek hai?
Nearly. Write: "This novel was very interesting. I finished it in one sitting." Drop "only"; it adds nothing here. Use a full stop or "and" between the two ideas, not just a comma.
'Mujhe akela mehsoos ho raha hai' English mein. Main naye sheher mein hoon.
Say: "I'm feeling lonely." You could add: "I've just moved to a new city, and I don't know many people yet." It's a good line to share with someone you trust.
What I should say when shopkeeper asks 'Anything else?' and I don't want?
Say: "No, that's all, thank you." Or: "That's it for today, thanks." A small fix for your question: "What should I say when the shopkeeper asks...?"
Ladakh trip ke liye likhna hai: 'Wahan bahut thandi hawa chalti hai.'
Write: "There is a very cold wind there." Or: "The wind there is freezing." "Freezing" is a casual way to say extremely cold.
Sentence check: 'Our neighbour is very helping person.'
Corrected: "Our neighbour is a very helpful person." The adjective is "helpful"; "helping" is a verb form. Also add "a" before "very".
Video call mein 'tumhari screen freeze ho gayi' bolna hai.
Say: "Your screen has frozen." Or: "Your video is stuck. Can you hear me?"
Fresher party mein khud ko introduce karna hai, fun way mein. Mera naam Imran, Mechanical branch, Lucknow se.
Try: "Hi everyone! I'm Imran from Lucknow. I'm in Mechanical, so if anything breaks, you know who to call. I love cricket and kebabs, and I'm happy to be here."
'Dal mein namak kam hai' - English mein?
Say: "The dal needs a little more salt." Or: "There isn't enough salt in the dal." The first one sounds kinder if someone else cooked it.
Mummy ko bolna hai 'Darwaza band kar do' politely, English practice ke liye.
Say: "Could you please close the door?" Or: "Mummy, please shut the door."
Kal PTM hai. Teacher se English mein kaise poochun ki mera beta class mein kaisa hai?
Ask: "How is Arjun doing in class?" You can add: "Is there anything he should work on?"
Aur agar teacher bole ki he talks too much?
You can reply: "Thank you for telling me. I'll talk to him about it at home."
'Mere bhaiya mujhse 5 saal bade hain' translate.
"My brother is five years older than me." You can also turn it around: "I'm five years younger than my brother."
Mera dost hamesha late aata hai. English mein mazaak mein kya bolun?
Try something light: "Look who finally made it!" or "Did you come by bullock cart today?" Keep your tone friendly so it stays a joke.
Is 'curd' and 'yogurt' same thing? My hostel friends from Kerala and from US argue.

In India, "curd" usually means homemade dahi. In most other countries, people say "yogurt" for the same kind of food. Both are right, but outside India "yogurt" is easier to understand. A small fix: "Are curd and yogurt the same thing?"
'Mujhe window seat chahiye' check-in counter pe kaise bolun?
Say: "Could I have a window seat, please?" If there are none left, you can ask: "Is there an aisle seat?"
Correct my email line: 'I am attaching herewith the file for your kind perusal.'
Simpler and clearer: "I have attached the file for you to review." Phrases like "herewith" and "for your kind perusal" sound old-fashioned. Plain English is easier to read.
Yoga class mein teacher ne bola 'Inhale deeply'. Inhale aur exhale ka matlab?
"Inhale" means breathe in. "Exhale" means breathe out. Example: "Inhale slowly through your nose, then exhale through your mouth."
'Main paise bacha raha hoon nayi cycle ke liye' English mein?
Say: "I'm saving up for a new bicycle." "Save up for" means keeping money aside to buy something later.
Durga Puja pandal dekhne gaye. Foreigner dost ko 'pandal' kaise samjhaun?
You can say: "A pandal is a large temporary structure made of cloth and bamboo. During Durga Puja, people build them to hold the goddess's idol, and many are beautifully decorated."
Coach wrote 'new PB' on my running sheet. What is PB?
"PB" means "personal best": your best result ever. Example: "I ran five kilometres in 28 minutes, a new personal best."
'Pahaadon pe barf giri hai' ko English mein?
Say: "It has snowed in the mountains." Or: "There's fresh snow on the hills."
What is 'bookworm'? Is it insult?
A "bookworm" is a person who loves reading and reads a lot. It is usually friendly, not an insult. Example: "My sister is a real bookworm; she reads every night."
Exam mein fail ho gaya. Ghar pe English mein kaise bataun? Bahut darr lag raha hai.

You can say: "I need to tell you something. I didn't pass the exam. I'm upset too, and I'll work hard to clear it next time." Telling them early is usually easier than waiting. It's normal to feel scared before this talk.
Fix: 'This dress is how much?'
Say: "How much is this dress?" In English questions, the question word usually comes first: "How much is it?" "Where is the shop?"
'Aaj dhoop bahut tez hai' English mein?
Say: "The sun is very strong today." Or: "It's really sunny and hot today." You might add: "Don't forget your cap."
Padosi ke ghar party hai, unhone invite kiya. 'Kya laaun?' English mein kaise poochun?
Ask: "Can I bring anything?" Or: "Is there anything I can bring?"
Wo bole 'Just bring yourself'. Matlab?
It means: "You don't need to bring anything. We just want you to come." It's a friendly way to say no gifts or food are needed.
'Mera balance khatam ho gaya' kaise bolein English mein?
Say: "My phone balance has run out." Or: "I've run out of credit on my phone."
Is 'I passed out from college in 2024' correct? My friend laughed.
In India, "passed out" is common, but in most places it means you fainted. Say: "I graduated from college in 2024" or "I finished college in 2024."
Sentence: 'First you boil the milk and then you put the sugar in it.' Ok for recipe?
It is correct, but recipes usually use short commands: "Boil the milk. Add the sugar and stir." Leave out "you" and start each step with a verb.
'Pankha saaf karna hai, seedhi kahan hai?' English mein bhai se kaise bolun?
Say: "I need to clean the fan. Where's the ladder?"
Teacher ne 'plagiarism' bola. Matlab kya hai?

"Plagiarism" means copying someone else's words or ideas and presenting them as your own. Example: "Copying a paragraph from a website without saying where it came from is plagiarism." Always mention your sources.
Sasural walon ke saamne English mein 'Aap log baithiye, main chai laati hoon' kaise bolun?
Say: "Please sit down, everyone. I'll bring some tea." Or: "Please make yourselves comfortable. I'll get the tea."
Mere dost ne naukri chhod di. 'Usne resign kar diya' English mein?
Say: "He has resigned from his job." Or, more casually: "He quit his job." Use "she" if your friend is a woman.
Sentence check: 'I am liking this paneer very much.'
Better: "I really like this paneer." "Like" describes a feeling, so we usually don't use the -ing form. You can also say: "This paneer is delicious."
Pehli baar metro mein ja rahi hoon. 'Kaunsa platform' kaise poochun?
Ask: "Which platform is the train to City Centre?" Or simply: "Which platform for City Centre?" Use the name of your station.
Aur card recharge karna ho toh?
Say: "I'd like to top up my card, please. Two hundred rupees." "Top up" means adding money to a card.
Boss ne bola 'Keep me in the loop'. What I should do?
It means: keep your boss informed. Copy them on emails about the work and share updates as they happen. Example: "Please keep me in the loop about the client meeting."
'Mujhe chot lag gayi' English mein, school nurse ko?
Say: "I've hurt myself." Then say where: "I've hurt my knee. I fell on the stairs."
What means 'pay through the nose'? My uncle said about his car repair.
It means to pay much more than something should cost. Example: "We had to pay through the nose for tickets at the last minute." Your uncle means the repair was very expensive.
Lohri pe bonfire hota hai. Ek chhota description English mein chahiye school diary ke liye.
"Lohri is celebrated in January, mostly in Punjab. In the evening, families light a bonfire, sing songs and throw peanuts, popcorn and sweets into the fire. It marks the end of winter."
'Mujhe team ka captain bana diya' - translate.
"I've been made captain of my team." Or: "I was chosen as the team captain."
Fix: 'Many birds was sitting on tree.'
Corrected: "Many birds were sitting on the tree." "Birds" is plural, so use "were". Add "the" before "tree".
'Kahani ka moral' English mein 'moral of the story' sahi hai na?
Yes, "the moral of the story" is correct. It means the lesson the story teaches. Example: "The moral of the story is that slow and steady wins the race."
Mera dost bahut udaas lag raha hai. English mein kaise poochun ki sab theek hai?
Ask gently: "Hey, you've seemed a bit quiet lately. Is everything okay?" Then give them time to answer.
Agar wo bole 'I'm fine' but lagta nahi?
You can say: "Okay. Just know I'm here if you ever want to talk." Staying in touch matters. If you are really worried, it's good to talk to a trusted adult or someone close to them.
'Mujhe bill chahiye' English mein?
Say: "Could I have the bill, please?" In a shop, you can also ask: "Can I get a receipt?"
Difference between 'weather' and 'whether'? I always mix.
"Weather" is about rain, sun and wind: "The weather is cold." "Whether" is used for choices or doubt, like "if": "I don't know whether to go."
Neighbour ka bachcha hamare ghar ki ghanti baja ke bhaag jaata hai. English mein uske papa ko kaise bataun?

Keep it light and friendly: "Hi, just letting you know, your son has been ringing our doorbell and running away. It's probably a game, but could you have a word with him?" "Have a word" means talk to someone briefly.
'Missed call de dena' English mein kya bolte hain?
Say: "Give me a missed call." People in India understand this. Elsewhere, you can say: "Ring me once, and I'll call you back."
Mere SOP mein likha hai 'I am having keen interest in physics since childhood'. Theek hai?
Better: "I have been interested in physics since I was a child." Or: "I have had a keen interest in physics since childhood." Use "have had" for something that started in the past and continues now.
'Sabzi jal gayi' English mein?
Say: "The vegetables got burnt." Or: "I burnt the sabzi." British English uses "burnt" and American English often uses "burned"; both are correct.
Is 'Close the light' correct? I say every night to my brother.
Say: "Turn off the light" or "Switch off the light." We close doors and windows, but we turn off lights and fans.
Exam hall mein invigilator ko kaise bolun ki mujhe extra sheet chahiye?
Raise your hand and say: "Excuse me, may I have an extra sheet, please?"
'Ghar mein sab kaise hain?' English mein relative se kaise poochun?
Ask: "How is everyone at home?" Or, more casually: "How's the family?"
Explain 'ghosting'. My friend says her friend ghosted her.
"Ghosting" means suddenly stopping all contact with someone without any explanation. Example: "We chatted every day, then he ghosted me." It often feels hurtful because there is no goodbye.
Bahut kha liya. 'Pet bhar gaya' ko English mein?
Say: "I'm full." Or, if you ate a lot: "I'm stuffed." To a host, "I couldn't eat another bite, it was delicious" is a kind way to say no to more.
Taxi driver ko 'AC on kar do' kaise bolun?
Say: "Could you please turn on the AC?"
Aur 'thoda dheere chalaiye'?
Say: "Could you please drive a little slower?"
Aur utarte waqt 'kitna hua'?
Ask: "How much do I owe you?" Or simply: "How much is it?"
HR is asking CV. What is difference between 'resume' and 'CV'?

They are very similar: both list your education, skills and work. A resume is usually short, one or two pages. A CV can be longer and more detailed, and in Britain and India "CV" is often used for any resume. Send what HR asks for: your CV.
'Mujhe chashma lagta hai' English mein?
Say: "I wear glasses." Or: "I wear spectacles." "Specs" is a casual short form.
Fix: 'Rent is too costly in this area, so we are searching cheap flat.'
Corrected: "Rent is very high in this area, so we are looking for a cheaper flat." We say rent is "high". Use "look for" or "search for", and add "a" before "cheaper flat".
'Mubarak ho' ke liye English mein general word?
Say: "Congratulations!" For a festival, you can say: "Happy Eid!" or "Best wishes!"
'Wo hamesha haar ke rota hai' matlab sore loser? Sahi word hai?
Yes. A "sore loser" is someone who gets upset or angry when they lose a game. Example: "Don't be a sore loser; shake hands and play again tomorrow."
Bachche ko samjhana hai: 'Patte hare kyun hote hain?' Simple English mein.
You can say: "Leaves are green because they have something called chlorophyll inside them. Chlorophyll helps the plant use sunlight to make its food."
Is 'author' and 'writer' same?

Mostly, yes. A "writer" is anyone who writes. An "author" usually means the person who wrote a particular book. Example: "Charlotte Bronte is the author of Jane Eyre." Ask it like this: "Are 'author' and 'writer' the same?"
Sentence check please: 'I am feeling boring today.'
Corrected: "I am feeling bored today." Use "bored" for how you feel. "Boring" describes the thing that makes you feel that way: "This film is boring."
Mall mein security guard ne bola 'Bag counter'. Kya karna tha?
It means you must leave your bag at the bag counter before going in. They give you a token, and you collect your bag with it when you leave.
'Kal se mausam badlega' English mein?
Say: "The weather will change from tomorrow." Or: "The weather is going to change tomorrow."
What means 'keep an eye on'? Neighbour asked 'Can you keep an eye on my house?'
It means to watch something and check that it is safe. Your neighbour is asking you to look at their house now and then while they are away. Example: "Could you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?"
Phone charge nahi ho raha. Dukaan pe 'Charging point dheela hai' kaise bolun?
Say: "The charging port is loose, so my phone won't charge." Then ask: "Can you fix it?"
Teacher said my essay is 'too verbose'. Mujhe ye shabd nahi pata.
"Verbose" means using more words than needed. Your teacher wants shorter, clearer sentences. Example: "His answer was verbose; he could have said it in two lines."
'Mixture ko thanda hone do' recipe mein kaise likhun?
Write: "Let the mixture cool." Or: "Allow the mixture to cool for ten minutes."
My mother says to guests 'Make yourself comfortable'. What means exactly?
It means: relax and feel at home here. Guests can sit where they like and don't need to be formal. Example: "Please come in and make yourself comfortable."
